name: Forensics CLI 101: The Aurora Case
description: A digital-forensics case worked from the command line, from arriving at the bench to carving a file out of a disk image. Written for a cyber-forensics course, and it teaches general CLI skill through the case. Assumes you have met a terminal before.

briefing.heading: The Aurora Case
briefing.body:
You are first on scene at the bench. The exhibits are logged, the machine is yours, and the case will be built from what you can show — not from what you remember doing.

Forensics work is ordinary command-line work done carefully. You will look at files without changing them, prove what a file really is rather than what it claims to be, and carry a number from one command into the next without writing it down wrong.

Act VI moves to the seized Windows laptop and does the same work again in cmd.exe, because a case does not choose its operating system for you.
youWillLearn: Get your bearings on an unfamiliar machine
Read a file’s true type from its magic bytes, not its extension
Take and check a forensic hash
Search a filesystem with grep and find
Build multi-stage pipelines that answer a real question
Read a partition table and carry a sector offset
Do the same work again in Windows CMD

courseTools.dd: a raw imaging tool used for disk acquisition
courseTools.hexdump: a hex viewer used to inspect file headers
courseTools.xxd: a hex viewer used to inspect file headers
courseTools.sha1sum: a hashing tool (this simulator has md5sum and sha256sum)
courseTools.openssl: a crypto toolkit used for hashing and certificates
courseTools.mmls: a Sleuth Kit tool for reading partition tables
courseTools.fsstat: a Sleuth Kit tool for filesystem details
courseTools.fls: a Sleuth Kit tool for listing files, including deleted ones
courseTools.icat: a Sleuth Kit tool for extracting file content by inode
courseTools.mactime: a Sleuth Kit tool for building timelines
courseTools.exiftool: a metadata reader for documents and images
courseTools.vol: the Volatility 3 command for memory forensics
courseTools.autopsy: the graphical front end to the Sleuth Kit

acts.name: Act IV: The Pipeline
acts.tagline: Pipes, redirection, filters, and multi-stage analysis
